operating_notes.text: Company has only one reportable business segment, Power Generation, and no subsidiary, associate or joint venture as on 31 March 2026.
Transitioned to the new concessional corporate tax regime from 1 April 2026, with deferred tax liabilities re-measured from 34.944% to 25.168%.
Capital work-in-progress stood at ₹2,065.72 Cr at 31 March 2026 against property, plant and equipment of ₹5,727.58 Cr.
Khavda solar plant CUF at 33%, evacuation issue ongoing
Debt of ₹4,500 Cr to be repaid over 5 years post-commissioning
Bondada Engineering accepted GIPCL's 11/08/2026 LOI for design, engineering, supply, erection, commissioning and O&M of a 120 MW/120 MWh BESS at GIPCL's plant; value and schedule not disclosed.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (standalone): revenue ₹428.26 Cr (+26.6% YoY), net profit ₹326.85 Cr (+368.7% YoY).
2026-10-17: GIPCL said Bondada Engineering accepted its 11/08/2026 LOI for a 120 MW/120 MWh BESS at its plant; no value disclosed.
